summary_en: 20,044,102 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 2026-06-30. Post-cancellation issued share count: 561,197,409 (treasury: 1,500,000). Represents 3.45% of pre-cancellation issued total.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, Nomura Research Institute's board of directors resolved under Company Law Article 178 to cancel 20,044,102 treasury ordinary shares, effective 30 June 2026. The shares represent 3.45% of the 581,241,511 issued shares outstanding as of the board meeting date. Post-cancellation, the company will have 561,197,409 issued shares and retain 1,500,000 treasury shares (0.27% of the post-cancellation issued base). The pct_so figure is computed as 20,044,102 ÷ (581,241,511 − 21,544,102) = 3.5% to one decimal, matching the issuer's stated 3.45% rounded.
